name: Ayanna Camille Monroe
source:
Zara is the technical point of reference for the Aegis, responsible for every computer system in the Tower.
Before being selected as an official member, she led the civilian tech team; the transition to the front line exposed her to a new kind of pressure, making her feel constantly under scrutiny.

An only child of two successful professionals, she grew up in an environment where excellence was the only measure of worth: learning not to make mistakes was her first form of discipline.
Today, Zara fears she’ll never truly be good enough, and finds refuges in order, training and meticulous control over every detail.
